findings.location: worked example: formula and metric class
findings.evidence: The supplied note explicitly calls activation rate a "percentage," but the artifact changes the class to "rate or percentage" and gives only a bare numerator/denominator ratio. The source supports percentage as the class; it does not support uncertainty between the two labels.
findings.consequence: The normalized card weakens an explicit source statement and leaves implementation ambiguous about whether the ratio is represented as a fraction or percentage.
findings.correction: Record the class as percentage. Express the formula as the activated-account ratio represented as a percentage, or as 100 multiplied by the ratio, while leaving only genuinely absent implementation details unresolved.
